experiment_data.hypothesis: Spectral-guided adaptive mixing with moderate gain (k=10, tau=0.002, per_gen mode) provides optimal balance between early response and budget conservation. k=10 is midpoint between k=20 (exp_005, fast budget depletion) and k=5 (cumulative mode, late trigger). Expect ratio to rise to ~0.55-0.65 at peak collapse gens, with more gradual budget consumption than k=20.

spec.description: Phase 1: Adaptive spectral-guided mixing (k=10, tau=0.002, per_gen mode, log_det signal), seed 42. 论文主实验.
spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/spectral_collapse_ews && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python run_phase1.py --condition adaptive --seed 42 --generations 10 --signal log_det --tau 0.002 --k 10 --signal_mode per_gen --gpu 0"
